about.title: About Us
about.p1: VFD Majšperk Breg is a voluntary fire department with a long tradition, founded in 1947. We are located at Breg 4, 2322 Majšperk.
about.p2: Our department is a key pillar of safety in the local community, where we strive to protect lives and property.

vehicles.title: Vehicle Fleet
vehicles.gvc1_desc: Fire engine with a tank (GVC-1) is intended for firefighting and technical rescue. Crew: 1+5 to 1+8. Tank: 2500L water and 200L foam. Pump: 2000 l/min at 10 bar. Equipment: Quick attack, light tower, breathing apparatus.
vehicles.gvm1_desc: Crew transport vehicle (GVM-1) is intended for transporting firefighters to interventions and youth to competitions. Crew: 1+8. Max weight: up to 3500kg (B category). Equipment: ZARE mobile station, first aid, site security equipment.

donations.title: Support Our Work
donations.dohodnina_desc: Every year you can donate up to 1.0% of your income tax to NGOs. It costs you nothing!
donations.desc: Your contribution helps us purchase equipment and maintain the unit.
